name: Lubei Big Data Center / Dezhihuilai Intelligent Computing Center
developer: Shandong Tianqu Big Data Technology Co.; Dezhou/Lingcheng project sponsors
notes: Shandong Development and Reform Commission reported the Lubei Big Data Center 'Dezhihuilai' intelligent computing center was lit up; Dezhou government materials describe a RMB 70 billion planned project with AI computing platform, cloud computing center, data trading/display center, digital manufacturing base and incubation facilities.

name: Lubei Big Data Center Source-Grid-Load-Storage Integration Project
developer: Shandong Tianqu Big Data Technology Co.
notes: Trade/local financial press reported a tender plan for power infrastructure serving the Lubei Big Data Center in Lingcheng, including 127.3 MW wind generation, 100 MW/200 MWh storage, 110 kV substations/lines and smart dispatch platform; capacity_mw reflects supporting generation, not IT load.

name: China Unicom Dezhou Cloud Computing Center
notes: C114 reported Dezhou Unicom's cloud computing center had been operating since June 2013, with 108 racks and 100G access bandwidth, described as the largest cloud computing center in northwest Shandong and southeast Hebei at the time.

name: Dongying Computing Power Center
developer: Dongying project sponsors; Inspur Communications Information systems integrator
notes: Qilu/Iqilu reported Dongying Computing Power Center had gone online, using Inspur micro-module smart data center and software-defined data center architecture to provide general, intelligent and high-performance computing.

name: Dongying Provincial New Data Center Portfolio
developer: China Mobile, China Unicom, China Telecom, Wanda Group, Dongkai Digital Technology, Lijin Future Digital Technology, Shandong Heneng Technology, Shandong Haishen Electronics, Guangrao Big Data Service Center and others
notes: A reposted Dongying Big Data Center assessment notice listed 11 proposed provincial new data centers, including China Mobile (Dongying) IDC, Shandong Dongying Unicom backbone cloud pool, Dongying Unicom Shengli Data Center, Wanda multi-format cloud computing data center, Dongying Software Park edge data center, Smart Lijin Cloud Computing Center, China Telecom (Dongying) Cloud Data Center and others.

name: Yellow River Delta Cloud Computing Center
notes: Caixin reported IBM and Dongying signed a strategic cooperation agreement for the Yellow River Delta Cloud Computing Center using IBM CloudBurst to support smart-city and e-government applications; current operating status was not verified in this batch.

name: Southwest Shandong Big Data Center (Luxinan Big Data Center)
notes: Select Shandong/Dazhong reported the center was launched in December 2017 in Heze Economic Development Zone and supports information center, data center and big-data industry functions; earlier local press said the project would form a city-level public information big data and cloud computing platform.

name: Southwest Shandong Big Data Center Intelligent Computing Upgrade
developer: Southwest Shandong Big Data Center project company
notes: A 2025 project summary lists a new-record project in Heze Development Zone/Yuecheng Subdistrict for 'Luxinan Big Data Center intelligent computing center upgrade construction'; treated as weak aggregate evidence because the original filing was not located.

name: Tianhua Cloud Data Center
developer: Tianhua E-Commerce Industrial Park / local operators
notes: Xinhua described 'Tianhua Cloud' as the Tianhua Cloud Data Center in Heze's Tianhua e-commerce industrial park, serving up to 2,000 companies with computing and data-decision support.

name: China Mobile (Jinan) Data Center
notes: KSTAR case page says China Mobile (Jinan) Data Center is a Tier 3 data center owned by China Mobile Group Shandong, covering 72,140 square meters, with first phase capacity for 7,000 racks.

name: Shandong Big Data Industry Base Complex / former Jinan Big Data Center
developer: Jinan/Shandong project sponsors; Aleatek design reference
notes: Architecture/project page identifies a Jinan, Shandong data-center/research/office/exhibition/commercial complex with 53,800 m2 site area and 369,700 m2 GFA; operating status and developer not verified from primary sources.

name: China Telecom Jinan Hub Building Data Center
notes: Datacenters.com lists China Telecom Jinan Hub Building Data Center at Shun Hua Lu, Lixia District, Jinan; treated as aggregate listing evidence.

name: Huawei Shandong (Jining) Big Data / Cloud Computing Data Center
notes: Shandong provincial agency page says the government cloud is deployed in Huawei Shandong Big Data Center in Jining High-tech Zone Information Industry Park, started May 2017 with planned total investment of RMB 2.1 billion; Sohu/Jining media reported 10 ha high-standard cloud data center, 1,064 cloud cabinets and 700 PB storage service capability.

name: Jiaxiang Dr. Peng Computing Power Center and Digital Economy Industrial Park
notes: Jining government reported the Jiaxiang County Dr. Peng computing center and digital economy industrial park has total investment of RMB 5.3 billion, is a provincial major project and a component of the Lunan Computing Power Center, with planned annual high-tech output of RMB 2 billion.

name: Liaoyun Data Lake Industrial Park Big Data Storage Center and Supercomputing Center
notes: Shandong MIIT page says Liaoyun Data Lake Industrial Park had built a big-data storage center and supercomputing center, alongside smart-society projects, to promote IoT, big data and cloud computing industry applications.

name: Liaocheng 500 PB Storage Computing Center
notes: Shandong MIIT reported Liaocheng planned to accelerate 5G commercialization and big data center construction, including a 500 PB storage computing center and more than 10 industrial internet platforms.

name: Huawei Linyi Cloud Computing Big Data Center / Yimeng Cloud Valley
developer: Huawei; Linyi Economic and Technological Development Zone
notes: Huawei case study says Linyi Big Data Center in Linyi Economic and Technological Development Zone has six standard modular computer rooms, over 1,000 19-inch cabinets and capacity for 10,000+ servers; Huawei supplied 1.2 MW power distribution plus evaporative cooling and DCIM. Dazhong reported the Yimeng Cloud Valley project started construction in April 2018 with RMB 1.2 billion investment.

name: China Mobile (Shandong Qingdao) Data Center / Qingyun Data Center Phase II
developer: China Mobile Shandong Qingdao Branch; CSCEC 8th Engineering Bureau contractor
notes: CSCEC reported China Mobile Qingdao Data Center Phase II topped out in Qingdao High-tech Zone, with total planned building area of 150,000 m2, three data-center buildings and power center, planned 20,000 racks after completion. Dazhong later described the center as a provincial key project with RMB 3.14 billion investment, 20,000 racks and 55T export bandwidth.

name: Qingdao Artificial Intelligence Computing Center
developer: Qingdao AI computing center operators / local government ecosystem
notes: Xinhua reported Qingdao AI Computing Center is Shandong's first AI computing center, with first-phase 100 PFLOPS capacity and more than 300 enterprise, university and research users.

name: Huawei Cloud Shandong Node Data Center
notes: Qingdao Daily reported Huawei Cloud Shandong node data center had completed construction in Qingdao and was expected to enter service within the year, with 300 air-cooled general-compute cabinets, 200 liquid-cooled AI cabinets and planned three-year scale of 2,000 PFLOPS, ultimately 3,000-4,000 PFLOPS.

name: Rizhao Smart City Cloud Computing Data Center
notes: Shandong MIIT described a Rizhao smart-city cloud computing project intended to build a large standardized, modular, intensive, green cloud computing data center providing e-government cloud, public-service cloud and industry cloud for Rizhao smart-city construction and operation.

name: Donghua Financial Cloud National Operations Center / Donghua Cloud reference in Rizhao
notes: Shandong MIIT reported Rizhao and Donghua Software would cooperate to build a financial technology headquarters base, with Donghua Financial Cloud national operations center, financial technology collaboration center and blockchain institute in Rizhao; treated as a cloud/data-center-adjacent project because facility details were not provided.

name: Tai'an Cloud Computing Center
developer: Tai'an High-tech Zone; Chengcheng IoT; Inspur Group; Shandong Zhongzhi Electronics operations reference
notes: Century Power reported the Tai'an Cloud Computing Data Center was approved by Tai'an government, organized by Tai'an High-tech Zone, jointly invested by Chengcheng IoT and Inspur Group with RMB 60 million investment and 4,800 m2 site area; Tai'an High-tech Zone later referenced Tai'an Cloud Computing Center certifications including national data center A-level room and MLPS level 3.
